the Casino scroll is 3,000 at Dex (was 300)

the World data window (admins): track.js's numbers over 1/7/14/30 days
WORLD EVENTS LAUNCHED: Shooting Stars, Wanted! and the Jackpot Thief (a run cycle, never the Yard, a 30-50k sack, health by fighters)
the Wild's new monsters drawn (their frames in the Wild and Deep art packs)
STAT TRACKING (track.js); THE WILDERNESS REARMED (new monsters, 1.25x/1.5x, a death costs 10%); fighting back needs a click in the last minute; every gem on the Gems page
a staff badge beside staff names in Who's online (mods too)
THE WEEKLY ISSUE (the wiki's Week pages, a snapshot a week)
THE BALANCE PASS, /find and the chat commands, the wiki rebuilt; world events built and HELD
WORLD EVENTS: Shooting Stars, Wanted! and the Jackpot Thief, one each a day; Who's online in the kit
THE ISLANDS: bigger, better-looking, eight themes, cottage styles, livestock
the Store: pet skins, eggs, bag slots, art for everything; the wiki pages its long tables
THE STORE, REBUILT: effects, titles, decor, the War Horn, 2X Skilling XP, the loupes, bank pages, quick slots; and "speed" walks

held.name: The Character window
held.what: Every number about you, and where to get more: a button in the Equipment tab.
held.ships: a new module (eastscape-char.js, probe it live first) and the page; no rules change

held.name: The admin window
held.what: The admin tab's 45 controls become a window with Live server / Players / Testing tabs: what's running, confirms on server-wide actions, a player card, a recent-actions log; moderators see only what they can run.
held.ships: a new page module (eastscape-admin.js: push and probe it before the page) and the worker (admin.js); no rules change

held.name: Thieving in the world, shortcuts and back ways
held.what: Pockets on 19 kinds of people-monster from Thieving 10 (a fail only stuns); a lockbox on 12 maps (lockpicks 1,000 at Vance; keys roll a Crypt or Pyramid hoard twice); a fenced Agility nook on all 12 maps with a spot one tier above the map's own; 5 walk-saving shortcuts; 3 back ways between far maps (the Scrap Run, the Ice Ledge, the Storm Drain); the Guild's stale words fixed.
held.ships: flip HOLD.thief2 to false, VERSION bump (shared ?v in eastscape.html), push and probe the new art and the rebuilt sprite sheets first, then the worker (thief.js, crypt.js, pyramid.js)

held.name: Abilities and the order (2a) · on hold
held.what: Built and tested, then held by the owner on 1 October: not fleshed out yet, and it waits for the first player to reach 99 in a combat skill. Not in the next batch.
held.ships: switched off by HOLD.abil (on only for a local ?open=1 test); turning it on later is the switch plus the nine ui/ab_*.png icons pushed and probed first

held.name: Skilling sets art
held.what: All 52 icons for the thirteen new sets, drawn; the code isn't written yet.
held.ships: nothing yet: the art waits for the feature

roadmap.title: Your screen
roadmap.text: Move anything on the screen, pick a look, and choose which names and plates show. Settings, under the gear.

roadmap.title: My stats
roadmap.text: Your own dashboard: where your time goes, where your tickets come from, what keeps killing you.

roadmap.title: World events
roadmap.text: Shooting Stars, Wanted! and the Jackpot Thief, one of each a day.

roadmap.title: The Wild, rearmed
roadmap.text: Late-map monsters, better pay for a kill, and dying there costs.

roadmap.title: Returns at Bom
roadmap.text: Bought the wrong gear? It goes back within the hour for what you paid.

roadmap.title: Play on your phone
roadmap.text: Every window and the tables, laid out for a phone, without chat in the way.

roadmap.title: Straight to a table
roadmap.text: Pick a table and go, from anywhere, and a two-minute lesson on how they work.

roadmap.title: The Store's Featured shelf
roadmap.text: A different set of looks every week, and a Mystery Bag.

roadmap.title: Gifting
roadmap.text: Buy something in the Store for a friend, with a note.

roadmap.title: Call the world
roadmap.text: Summon the Pumpkin King, start a Lucky Hour, or call Nightfall for everyone.

roadmap.title: A waystone home
roadmap.text: One stone that always takes you to your island.

roadmap.title: A new map, under the Thunderhead
roadmap.text: Somewhere hot and deep, with its own monsters, a boss at the bottom, and better pets. The rumours below know more.

roadmap.title: New chase items
roadmap.text: Rare drops worth hunting on the late maps: rings, amulets and weapons with effects of their own, a few of them one in a thousand.

roadmap.title: A fourth world event
roadmap.text: Something new for the whole server, once a day. Tell us what you'd want it to be.

roadmap.title: A new map, past the Boneyard's wall
roadmap.text: Something green and tended on the other side of a wall nobody remembers building.

roadmap.title: Monsters past level 99
roadmap.text: Fights for the very top of the server: monsters above level 99, and a reason to keep upgrading.

roadmap.title: Your ideas, in the game
roadmap.text: Send an idea from the game and see it land here.

roadmap.title: Something is burning underneath
roadmap.text: Miners on the Thunderhead's south ridge say the rock is warm to the touch, and something down there hammers all night.

roadmap.title: Past the wall, it's green
roadmap.text: There's a wall at the bottom of the Boneyard nobody remembers building, and on the other side, somebody is tending an orchard.

roadmap.title: Past the top, you choose what you become
roadmap.text: The old hands at the top of the hiscores talk about a road past mastery: pick one way to fight and give yourself to it, and it gives you something nobody else has. Nobody who's walked it has come back the same.

phases.title: Phase 0: sharpen what exists
phases.why: Four small things that everyone feels, and the two fixes that have to come before anything taller.

items.name: The character stats window
items.detail: Mockup 9, today's stats only. No server work. Approved 1 October after testing it in the game; built and held, it ships with the rest of phase 0.

items.name: Defence past 90 (dropped)
items.detail: Measured properly, defence works up to 99. The real fix is monster attack past 100, which moves to phase 2.

items.name: Abilities and the order (2a), on hold
items.detail: Built and tested 1 October, then held by the owner: not fleshed out yet, and it waits for the first 99 in a combat skill. Switched off (HOLD.abil); not in the phase 0 batch.

items.name: Backups
items.detail: The to-do in EASTSCAPE-LAUNCH.md. Before pets and diaries exist.

items.name: The weekly community boss (from 8)
items.detail: One boss a week for the whole server, week-long health, a three-together finish, on the raid code. The Whale first.
items.effort: 1 week · 4 bosses, one at a time

phases.title: Phase 1: things to do at every level
phases.why: The two mockups that work for the whole server at once, and the ones with the best value for their cost.

items.name: Open the Orchard Wall and the Foundry (atlas)
items.detail: Both built and held. Woodcutting 52-66 and Mining 70-90 on second maps, two more combat bands, art that already exists.

items.name: Thieving in the world and shortcuts (Thieving & shortcuts)
items.detail: Settled 1 October: pockets on 19 kinds of people-monster and a lockbox per map from Thieving 10 (a fail only stuns, lockpicks 1,000); a shortcut per map, 10 to 95, cutters where the map detours and ledges with one extra gathering spot where it doesn't. Built on dev 1 October and held for the next batch (HOLD.thief2). The Run's lanes are still open.

items.name: Pets that grow (7)
items.detail: Levels, stages, traits, pedigree, hand-raised, treats. Elder art for the six drop pets; the rest staged.

items.name: Area diaries (6)
items.detail: Eight regions, four tiers, every task a counter. Perks, lamps, medals, the hiscore. The cape waits for the slot.

items.name: A trophy wall in the Yard (from 8)
items.detail: A Tinkerer project that mounts every boss the server has beaten, with who was there.

items.name: Skilling sets and work clothes (Sets)
items.detail: 14 four-piece sets, each dropping from another skill; the Ditched set gains its all-four bonus. Work clothes on the paper doll (option A, chosen 1 October) and the pips on the skill tiles. All 52 icons are drawn.

items.name: Ticket sinks, the first four (Sinks)
items.detail: Tag the flows the tracker misses, then the weekly auction, buy-a-round 2X (the War Horn's pattern), the Back Room gamble and the rising reforge. For the regulars something to want, for the three savers something worth a million.

phases.title: Phase 2: the road past 99
phases.why: Lands the month the first players reach 99. The re-picked curve, the first two unlocks, and Mythic so the Black Crypt has somewhere to go.

items.name: The Tidepools and the Ashlands (atlas)
items.detail: The two gateways at 98-106: every gathering skill's 100-105 tier, camp chests, the Rumbles event moves to the Ashlands. So 99 has somewhere to go.

items.name: Levels 100-120 (1)
items.detail: The hybrid curve, unlocks at 100 and 105 for every skill, the cape slot, the first Mastery capes (the combat skills' and the four biggest skilling ones), the Max Cape rule.

items.name: Mythic 1-9 and the Tower climb (5)
items.detail: Keys, the clock, the twists, the Vault, the Hall. No roles. The twist icons are drawn.

items.name: The 110 and 115 unlocks
items.detail: Data only, switched on as players arrive; the new resources wait for their maps.

items.name: Monster attack and defence past 100
items.detail: The slope keeps going above 100 so the Valley and the Frozen Reach stay dangerous for players with levels past 99; checked with the stats window's hit chances.

phases.title: Phase 3: who you become
phases.why: The first 100s are picking a path by now. Resistances land here because sockets and the first map both want them.

items.name: The Elderwood (atlas, 4)
items.detail: The first endgame map, moved down to 104-112: Woodcutting 106/110, Fishing 106, Mining 108, Farming and Fungiculture 106-110; the Rootmother.

items.name: Ascendancies (2b)
items.detail: The trials in the Hall of Ascension, the six paths with their trees, the Mender first (Mythic's recommended healer), signature moves.

items.name: Resistances and sockets (9b, 3)
items.detail: Frost and fire as damage types, wards as 75%, element gems in armour sockets resist, the socket tab at the Gem Sorter, the Primordial gem from the bosses that exist.

items.name: Quality on every craft (3)
items.detail: Normal / fine / superior / masterwork on everything made, with the maker's name. Relic shards from the Wyrm, Rex and the Jarl.

phases.title: Phase 4: under the mountain
phases.why: The first endgame map, where the rumour already points, timed for the first players near 110.

items.name: The Underforge (4)
items.detail: One map, heat as fire damage, four monsters and the Forgemaster at launch, the Heart of the Mountain as the daily boss a month later. The Mountain Rumbles event for everyone over 50.

items.name: Mining and Smithing 110 (1)
items.detail: Primordial ore and bars, the Ancient Forge moves down from the Thunderhead.

items.name: Relic weapons and armour (3)
items.detail: The tier at 110, forged at the Ancient Forge from the shards, the bars and the Forgemaster's tongs.

items.name: Mythic 10+ (5)
items.detail: With roles recommended, now that healers exist.

phases.title: Phase 5: two more places
phases.why: The maps that bring the rest of the 110 resources and the sets, one a quarter.

items.name: The High Strip (atlas)
items.detail: The endgame's town: a bank, every station, the Exchange, Thieving 112-120, the High Wire, the Kennel Club.

items.name: The Deep End (4)
items.detail: Fishing and Cooking 110; the Leviathan as the first fight that needs a Mender.

items.name: The remaining Elders (7)
items.detail: A few a month, each a CASINO line.

phases.title: Phase 6: the top of the game
phases.why: For the first 120s, who the clock says exist by then only on the re-picked curve.

items.name: The Star Archive (4)
items.detail: Wizardry, Agility and Alchemy 110; the Archivist.

items.name: Awakened Relic at 120 and the Max Cape (1, 3)
Mythic seasons, the second season's twists (5)
